Description.Name: The Goat and the Lutefisk
Description.Details: You and Jarl are searching the outskirts of a settlement on Goatpath when Jarl raises the modified electronic whistle Capt Jack gave you before leaving the {COMPANY.CompanyName}. Jarl blows the whistle. Nothing happens. He blows it again. A familiar voice suddenly calls out from somewhere nearby. "Stop blowing that ridiculous thing!" The Chemist emerges from behind a nearby building, already laughing."You actually believed that absurd device could summon a goat?" He shakes his head, still laughing. "An electronic whistle that supposedly calls animals from across the countryside? That's one of the most ridiculous things I've ever heard." When he sees Jarl standing beside you, his laughter fades into a grin. "Jarl. I should have known you'd be involved in this." Jarl gives him a skeptical look. "You gave me the recipe. Of course I'm involved." The Chemist laughs again. "Fair point. And I suppose you're here for Sheila." Jarl nods. "I need her milk for the Lutefisk ammunition." "Then you're in luck. I know exactly where she is." The Chemist turns and starts to walk away, "Wait here. I'll bring her to you." A short while later, the Chemist returns with a familiar snowy-white goat in tow. "Here she is. Sheila, back where she belongs." Jarl's face immediately brightens as Sheila bleats and pulls toward him. "Good girl." The Chemist hands Sheila's lead to Jarl. "Now remember, the goat's milk isn't the whole recipe. You still need prepared lutefisk. The specially fermented goat's milk has to be combined with the lutefisk to make the ammunition. The ammunition goes into that twenty-five-tube monstrosity you're building. Without the lutefisk, Sheila's milk won't get you very far." Jarl nods, then looks down at Sheila, then back toward you. "Commander, I believe we've found what we came for."

Description.Name: Welcome Sheila Aboard
Description.Details: Add a Goat to the Argo's Roster

Description.Name: Sheila in Da House
Description.Details: You nod. "All right. Let's get Sheila aboard the Argo." Jarl leads Sheila toward the waiting transport. The Chemist follows for a short distance before stopping. "Don't forget the lutefisk, Jarl! Sheila is just one half of the recipe, but you still need the prepared fish before you can make the ammunition for your launcher." Jarl raises a hand in acknowledgment. "I haven't forgotten, just need to figure out who will have the quantities I need." The Chemist grins. "Your best bet will be the Jarnfolk. More specifically, try their capital on Trondheim." You look at Sheila as she follows Jarl toward the transport. Somehow, the {COMPANY.CompanyName} has just acquired a goat in the middle of a mission to build a twenty-five-tube mortar launcher that fires ammunition made from goat's milk and lutefisk. You decide not to think about that too carefully. Sheila the Goat is now a member of your crew.
